mapper.select: SELECT o.id as id, o.order_id as orderId, o.product_id as productId, o.quantity as quantity, p.product_name as productName, p.product_image as productImg, p.product_price as productPrice FROM shop_order_item o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT o.order_id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, o.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, a.receiver_name as receiverName, a.phone AS receiverPhone, CONCAT(a.region, a.detail_address) AS fullAddress, o.shipping_channel as shippingChannel, o.tracking_number as trackingNumber, o.order_status as orderStatus, o.order_amount as orderAmount, o.payment_amount as paymentAmount, o.shipping_fee as shippingFee, o.discount_amount as discountAmount, o.points_deduction as pointsDeduction, o.payment_time as paymentTime, DATE_FORMAT(o.delivery_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as deliveryTime FROM shop_order o LEFT JOIN shop_user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN shop_address a ON o.address_id = a.address_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_order_item ( order_id, product_id, quantity, create_by, update_by ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy} )
